text: The Nominating Panel - Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Multi-Tenant Licensing Tribunal recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Multi-Tenant House Licensing Tribunal for a term of office ending on February 8, 2028, and until successors are appointed: Owen Chambers Emily McKernan
